documents.title: Ostrevia Patient Medication Information (Canada)
documents.content:
Serious Warnings and Precautions
• Serious infections: OSTREVIA can lower your ability to fight infections. Some infections, including tuberculosis, have led to hospital stays or death.
• Cancer: some people taking OSTREVIA have had cancers, including lymphoma.
• Blood clots: blood clots in the legs or lungs have happened and can be life-threatening.
